audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Vayne four of seven stages and Malphite none, in a lane Malphite wins 54.36% over 2614 games, and it contradicts the entry's own text at three of those stages: mid says 'Level 3 is where it flips to me', whys[2] says 'you out-trade her in melee', whys[5] says 'force the kill here'.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are hers and the last stage genuinely is too — Silver Bolts is percent-max-health true damage and armour does nothing to it. But Levels 3 through first item belong to Malphite, because Ground Slam cuts attack speed on a flat 7s against a champion whose damage is entirely attack-speed driven.
audit.corrected: Vayne owns Levels 1-2 and the two-item stage. Levels 3 through first item are Malphite's, which is what the prose already argues and what 54.36% supports.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3], wants.foe[2], late and whys[6] all attribute Vayne's invisibility to her Q: 'Q invis lets her dodge your telegraphed R', 'her Q invis vanish mid-dash'.
audit.why: Tumble does not grant invisibility on its own. Final Hour does — 'Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed'. The invisibility exists only while her ultimate is running, and it comes with a shorter Tumble on top. That changes the whole spike: the dodge threat is not permanent from level 3, it is a 100/85/70s window she has to spend, against your 130/115/100s. If you make her burn Final Hour to survive, your next ultimate arrives into a Vayne with no invisibility at all.
audit.corrected: The invisibility is Final Hour's, not Tumble's — it only exists while her ultimate is up, on 100/85/70s against your 130/115/100s. Outside Final Hour, Tumble is just an attack reset and your R cannot be vanished out of.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json (R Final Hour: 'Invisibility during Tumble', cd 100/85/70; Q Tumble, autoReset)

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn appears four times as a stun with no condition attached — 'Condemn (E) you into a wall to stun', 'when her condemn is on cooldown' — and no cooldown number anywhere.
audit.why: Condemn knocks back and only stuns if the target collides with terrain: 'knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.' In open ground it is a reposition, not a stun. That gives Malphite a positional rule the entry never states — fight her away from walls and the worst outcome is being pushed, not pinned. It is also 20s at rank 1, far and away her longest cooldown and the one worth counting before you commit.
audit.corrected: Condemn only stuns if it slams you into terrain — in the open it just pushes you. 20s at rank 1 falling to 12s, 550 range. Take the fight off the wall and count the 20 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tumble's attack reset is never mentioned, only its mobility ('tumble-kites', 'tumbles around'). Silver Bolts is described as stacking off autos only.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags this pairing for autoreset-burst-tell, and it is the right flag: Tumble resets her attack, so her burst opens with a roll into an immediate empowered hit rather than with a visible ability cast — the roll is the cue to step back, not the thing to walk into. Silver Bolts also procs on the third consecutive attack OR ability against the same target, which means Tumble and Condemn advance the stack too. A player counting only autos will misjudge when the true-damage tick lands.
audit.corrected: Tumble is an attack reset — the roll is the wind-up, so react to the roll, not to a cast. Silver Bolts counts abilities as well as attacks, so Tumble and Condemn advance the third-hit true damage.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vayne.json (Q Tumble, autoReset; W Silver Bolts: 'third consecutive attack or ability against the same target')

Worth preserving exactly as it stands. Ground Slam's attack-speed cut against an attack-speed damage profile is likewise correctly identified as the reason Levels 3-5 belong to Malphite.

notes: This entry was one of the better ones in the file — the Silver Bolts warning (percent-max-health TRUE damage, so armour and health both fail, and the late 1v1 is lost) is correct and I left it intact. Two real corrections. (1) Four strings credit Tumble with the invisibility that dodges your ultimate. It belongs to Final Hour: 'Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown'. That matters because it turns a permanent threat into a 100/85/70s window against your 130/115/100s — outside her ultimate, your R cannot be vanished on. (2) Condemn was called a stun four times with no condition. It knocks back and only stuns on collision with terrain, which gives the player a rule the entry never had: take the fight off the wall and the worst case is a push. Added its 20s rank-1 cooldown, her longest. Also added the autoreset-burst-tell that _missing-interactions.json flags — Tumble resets her attack, so the roll is the wind-up to react to, and Silver Bolts counts abilities as well as attacks, so Tumble and Condemn advance the true-damage stack. VOICE: early, mid and late were first person; the rewrites are in the site's second person. NOT EDITED: the chart gives Vayne four of seven and Malphite none in a 54.36% lane, contradicting mid, whys[2] and whys[5] — win[2] through win[5] should read Malphite or Skill. Enum values, outside the length band. The packet's two suspectNames rows for this matchup are both false positives; 'Ground Slam' and 'Unstoppable Force' are correct Malphite names.
